pictures.author: Osama Shukir Muhammed Amin FRCP(Glasg)
pictures.observed: Deep arcade with mottled grey shafts, faceted pale capitals/gold collars, alternating pale/grey arch stones and dark tie rods. Pale chamber walls carry a narrow blue frieze, framed lower windows/door panels; underside has a pale geometric coffer grid. Art/inscriptions excluded.

pictures.author: Shoakat hossain
pictures.observed: Whole raised pavilion/corner view: very broad shallow swept lead canopy, open arched colonnade, low pale open balustrade, enclosed pale chamber/two window levels and a framed arched entrance. Side steps, low stone plinth and plain canopy mass remain visible. Trees/hedges/visitors excluded.
